Name: Cuter Seasonal Nyapu Colored Sprites (SVE UPDATE)
Author: AlmostMidnight
Description:
[size=4][b]Disclaimer! [i]You don't need the Nyapu portraits mods or the seasonal Nyapu portraits mod for this mod to work[/i]. You do need [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic[/url]. If you want to use the vanilla portraits from that mod or a different portrait mod, just use the [CP] Seasonal Cute Characters and [CP] Seasonal Cute Characters SVE files from my mod to replace only the sprites.[/b][/size]

I adore [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23085]Eunoia's Nyapu Colored Sprites[/url], but I also use Seasonal Cute Characters and wanted to be able to enjoy them both. And so this mod was born!
Of course, massive credit to Eunoia's original Nyapu Colored Sprites for the basic outfit colors and beach sprites. Keep an eye out for their brand new sprites mod, the sample sprites look amazing!

Installation:

You don't [i]need[/i] the CP version of the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/36255]Seasonal SDV Outfit Nyapu Style Retextures[/url]﻿--since that mod also offers manual replacements--or the original [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11491]Nyapu's Portraits[/url] since this mod will replace the sprites in the original Seasonal Cute Characters mod. HOWEVER, I highly recommend you install all three and just replace the files for all of them. This will prevent any characters from being skipped that the Seasonal Cute Characters mod doesn't replace (ie: Gil, Bear, etc.)

1. Download the CP Version (preferably) of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/36255]Seasonal SDV Outfit Nyapu Style Retextures[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic[/url] and put them in your mod folder
2. Download my main mod file
3. Unzip and place the folders in your mods folder, make sure to replace everything. If you only have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits - Slighlty Cuter Aesthetic[/url] only use the [CP] Seasonal Cute Characters folder.
4. If you want my Alternate Penny or Sam, make sure to download them after the main file and replace everything for the mods you have installed.

And you're all set!
